name: Imi's Pizzeria
kurzbeschreibung: **Imi’s Pizzeria in Mittersill** – where authentic Italian flavors meet the charm of the **Tirol** Alps. Just a short stroll from the heart of **Mittersill**, this cozy spot serves up handmade pizzas with fresh, local ingredients—think crispy crusts, gooey mozzarella, and a touch of Alpine freshness. Don’t miss their signature **Kaiserschmarrn** for dessert, fluffy and caramelized to perfection. Perfect for a relaxed meal after a day of hiking or skiing in the stunning **Hohe Tauern** region. **Reservierungen** recommended, especially on weekends! 🍕❄️
